title: Thermodynamics of the canonical ensemble and the fluctuation–dissipation theorem
summary: Extended the canonical ensemble in Physlib from its basic definitions to the main thermodynamic results. Added a semi-classical normalisation, with a phase-space unit and a number of degrees of freedom, so that the partition function, Helmholtz free energy and thermodynamic entropy are dimensionless physical quantities, kept alongside their raw mathematical versions. Proved the identity F = U − TS, the mean energy as U = −∂ log Z/∂β, the relation between thermodynamic and differential entropy, and, for finite systems, that the thermodynamic entropy equals the Shannon entropy. Defined energy variance and heat capacity, and proved the fluctuation–dissipation theorem C_V = Var(E)/(k_B T²) for finite canonical ensembles. Made Temperature a structure and added the conversions, limits and derivatives in temperature that these results need.
